page.content:
The Cream Puff Gentleman is a Candy Person. In the episode "Little Dude," Little Dude possesses him, causing him to become very strong. He is used as a weapon, punching a candy horse and smashing buildings.

page.overview:
Who is Cream Puff Gentleman?

The Cream Puff Gentleman is a Candy Person. In the episode "Little Dude," Little Dude possesses him, causing him to become very strong. He is used as a weapon, punching a candy horse and smashing buildings.

Before Little Dude possessed him, he wore a suit, had a monocle, and wore a pink bowtie. When he was possessed, he ripped his suit, had a big muscular body, and his eyes turned green.
